title: Installing and Configuring DRF
description: Add DRF to your Django project and set up basic configuration.

slides.title: Installation
slides.content:
Install DRF using pip:

```bash
pip install djangorestframework
```

slides.title: Add to INSTALLED_APPS
slides.content:
In your project's `settings.py`, add `'rest_framework'` to `INSTALLED_APPS`:

```python
INSTALLED_APPS = [
    ...
    'rest_framework',
]
```

slides.title: Basic Configuration (Optional)

quizData.question: After installing DRF, what do you need to add to INSTALLED_APPS?

slides.title: Pro Tip 💡
slides.content:
## Include `rest_framework.authtoken` for token authentication

If you plan to use token authentication, also add `'rest_framework.authtoken'` to `INSTALLED_APPS` and run `migrate`.
